continuity_definition.common_bookmaker_set: intersection of bookmakers with complete valid H/D/A at every suffix 47..70

predeclared_representation_choice_rule: if minimum common-bookmaker count across both training and holdout is >=5: R39E must use each match's all-hours common bookmaker set for every T-24..T-1 consensus
else if minimum common-bookmaker count across both partitions is >=3: R39E must use each match's all-hours common bookmaker set for every T-24..T-1 consensus
else: R39E must use dynamic per-hour consensus with bookmaker count and draw-dispersion channels; no sample may be dropped
